checkpoints.title: Borrowing a puzzle box
checkpoints.reference: At the fictional Cedar Reading Club, members borrow one puzzle box at a time. Record its code in the checkout log so the next volunteer can trace who has it. Return the box to the blue shelf after use. The room opens at 09:00.
checkpoints.question: Explain how to borrow and return a puzzle box, including why its code is recorded.

criteria.text: Say a member may borrow only one puzzle box at a time.
Explain that recording the box code lets the next volunteer trace who has it.
Say the box must be returned to the blue shelf after use.

checkpoints.title: Checking a returned puzzle
checkpoints.reference: A completed puzzle is reset into its original arrangement. Pieces are counted before the box is closed. If a piece is missing, place a missing-piece note inside the box; do not mark the set complete.
checkpoints.question: Explain how to check and pack a returned puzzle, including what to do if a piece is missing.

criteria.text: Reset the puzzle into its original arrangement.
Count the pieces before closing the box.
If a piece is missing, put a note inside the box and do not mark the set complete.
